newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to press on with industry overhaul.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to press on with industry overhaul.

text.p: Croatia will press on with overhauling its troubled economy and focus on state firms in key industrial sectors which will be privatised, Deputy Economy Minister Jasna Boric said on Monay.
Some of these companies, including shipyards, a steel mill and metallurgical factories, are on the brink of folding under a huge debt burden and must lay off workers.
"At the moment there are 14 companies under rehabilitation and 10 or so others in which the government also approved certain measures," Boric told a news conference.
She said aid measures included writing off or rescheduling debts to state institutions and banks, a move that goes hand in hand with an advancing process of bank rehabilitation.
To help other ailing companies, the government has swapped their liabilities to creditors for its holdings in them, charging them also for their further revitalisation.
Boric said it planned to offer most firms for sell-off to investors who come up with a viable development strategy.
She said direct payouts in 1997 for subsidies from the economy ministry coffers, would total 420 million kuna. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
